correctness.rationale: Exact two upper triangular parameter products are derived from min-plus multiplication, and finite (3,1) forces the last permutation image to be column one. For 321, four nonnegative defects are forced, and strictness of defects two and three forces the fifth nonnegative; case-split explicit parameters reconstruct all other possibilities. For 231, defect one vanishes and three others are nonnegative; another explicit factor witness proves sufficiency. The strict counterexample has defects (2,3,3,1,-3). The standalone verifier passed 200000 random forward, 200000 random conditional inverse, 39366 small-box tests and three wing tests; this does not replace the universal real-variable proof.
